title: nda-eml-poc: EML proof-of-concept for Native Dialectical Architecture
description: Proof-of-concept code and experimental artifacts for the EML branch of Native Dialectical Architecture: hierarchical macro-node discovery, Gate 6, Gradient Freeze, RLCR ordering and Taylor-trap rejection.
notes: Checksum manifest hotfix release. Supersedes v1.0.2-paper for manuscript citation because v1.0.2-paper contained a SHA256SUMS manifest that referenced local Python bytecode cache files not present in the GitHub/Zenodo source archive. No experimental code, Stage 1-4 result logic, figures, or reported numerical claims were changed. Related manuscript/preprint DOI or arXiv ID should be added after public preprint release.
